items.title: Can I change my seat after booking?
items.description: Yes, you can change your seat after booking through Manage My Booking, subject to availability and fare rules.

items.title: Are seats free or paid?
items.description: Some seats are complimentary based on your fare type, while preferred or extra-legroom seats may require an additional fee.

items.title: Is seat selection available for infant booking ?
items.description: Seat selection for bookings with infants depends on aircraft configuration and available seating policies at the time of travel.

items.title: Is in-flight entertainment available for children?
items.description: In-flight entertainment options for children vary by aircraft. Where available, family-friendly content is offered onboard.

textWithBlobImage.title: A More Enjoyable Flight for Little Travelers
textWithBlobImage.description: Travel moments are more beautiful when our children are happy, that's why we designed our onboard children's toys to add a fun and entertaining mood during flights, ensuring they have a pleasant time filled with laughter and joy.

callUs.upperText: Customer Support Hotline: Open from 9 AM to 9 PM

twoColumnIntro.title: We're Here to Support Your Family Journey

That's why we offer a range of special services and guidance to make your family's journey as smooth and stress-free as possible. From priority boarding to in-flight entertainment, we've got you covered at every step.
